about: Kitchener is in Waterloo Region, in southwestern Ontario, paired with neighbouring Waterloo and Cambridge. It is a former manufacturing city that has become a centre for insurance, tech, and post-secondary education. Downtown sits along a former industrial corridor now served by ION light rail. About 260,000 people live in Kitchener.
seoSummary: Waterloo Region’s largest city, a former factory town now tied to tech and insurance.
knownFor: Tech and insurance alongside older factories
Oktoberfest, among the largest outside Germany
ION light rail shared with Waterloo
